result:
Summary: The HotpotQA Yang 2018 Hits@10 fullwiki BM25 DPR retrieval table shows a retrieval performance in the full wiki setting with a Mean Average Precision (MAP) of 43.21% and Hits@10 at 55.88% on the test set. This indicates that the gold paragraphs are not consistently among the top retrieved documents, which impacts the QA model's ability to answer questions as it relies on these retrieved paragraphs for context. The drop in performance is largely attributed to the difficulty of retrieving both entities necessary for answering a question, particularly for bridge entity questions.
